name: Enigmarella
source:
A Visual Novel set in a nautical steampunk universe, Enigmarella is the story of Alice, an orphan, whose life takes an unexpected turn when she is forced into an arranged marriage.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《谜》是一部以航海蒸汽朋克宇宙为背景的视觉小说，讲述了孤儿爱丽丝的故事，当她被迫接受包办婚姻时，她的生活发生了意想不到的转变。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812340/]Steam[/url]]
